newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria praises Deng as a friend, visionary leader.
newsitem.headline: Algeria praises Deng as a friend, visionary leader.

text.p: Algeria's President Liamine Zeroual on Thursday praised China's Deng Xiaoping as a friend and a visionary leader who lifted his country to development and prosperity.

"The work undertaken by the great leader Deng Xiaoping commands admiration and respect. His actions in favour of developing China and bringing about peace and prosperity to the world marked the path of your country towards modernisation and progress," said Zeroual in a condolence letter.
"Algeria loses in him a friend and the world a visionary leader," said Zeroual in his letter sent to Deng's chosen heir, Ziang Ziamin.
The letter was reported by the official Algerian news agency APS.
